summary: Sets or clears bit 5 (value 0x20) of the dword at this + 0x80 depending on the boolean parameter a2, stores the updated dword back, and returns it. Called from ConditionalRenderPipelineDispatch to toggle a state flag on a render-related object.

operations.description: Read the current dword value v2 from this + 0x80.
Branch on parameter a2: non-zero sets the flag, zero clears it.
When a2 is non-zero, set bit 5 by OR-ing the value with 0x20.
When a2 is zero, clear bit 5 by AND-ing the value with 0xFFFFFFDF.
Write the updated dword back to this + 0x80.
Return the updated dword value as the unsigned result.
